title: Group By Changes Period Format
description: Switching from a daily view to a monthly one should collapse the whole table's period column into month-shaped labels — not leave a mix of formats, and not just relabel the same rows.
successCondition: With a date range spanning at least two months, setting "Group by" to "Day" and clicking Update renders period values in the data table matching YYYY-MM-DD; switching "Group by" to "Month" and clicking Update again re-renders the same range with fewer rows, each period value matching YYYY-MM (no day component) — and the sum of shipmentCount across the monthly rows equals the sum across the daily rows for the same overall range.
hints: The row count should genuinely drop when switching to Month grouping (multiple days collapse into one bucket) — if it doesn't change, the toggle likely isn't wired to the request.
Cross-checking the totals between the two groupings is a strong correctness signal beyond just checking the label format looks different.
